repairs.quote: Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional (4% ~ 10%) max Health magic damage and restore 100% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to 25% against minions. This effect has a (22 ~ 10) second cooldown. Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.
